name: Blatella
source:
Occupation: Journalist.

Skills/Abilities: Focused, determined, and curious to the point of being nosy.

Notes: I have heard people saying he is rude and usually doesn't respect people's personal space. He will do anything to get answers and is extremely greedy. The perfect type for my experiment.
